DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • Their Pillar of Frost is active, as it amplifies their burst window and benefits from haste.
  • They activate Empower Rune Weapon, ensuring maximum resource regeneration during the haste buff.
  • They have trinket or temporary damage amplification procs active and are in an offensive cooldown phase.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • There is at least 1 active enemy, and they’re in a single-target phase or active add phase.
  • Their Summon Gargoyle is active with ≤22 seconds remaining, or they’re casting Dark Transformation.
  • If they skipped Summon Gargoyle and use Army of the Dead:
    • Their Raise Abomination is active with <18 seconds remaining.
    • If they skipped Raise Abomination: Army ghouls are active with ≤18 seconds remaining.
  • If they skipped both Summon Gargoyle and Army of the Dead, and Dark Transformation is active.
  • Their Summon Gargoyle is unavailable for the next 10 seconds, preventing timing conflicts.
  • Against ≥3 enemies while Dark Transformation or Death and Decay is active.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • The Demonhunter has Metamorphosis active (their primary burst window).
  • The encounter will end in 20 seconds or less to maximize damage output before combat ends.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • Their major cooldowns are ready (cd_condition) and they do not have the TWW 4pc Keeper of the Grove tier set bonus.
  • They have the TWW 4pc Keeper of the Grove tier set bonus and are entering a burst phase with either a single (kotg_single_ca_condition) or double (kotg_double_ca_condition) Celestial Alignment window.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • they activate Berserk: Incarnation, or
  • their build excludes the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • Dragonrage is active and any of the following: Shattering Star is on cooldown, Shattering Star's debuff is present, or there are 2 or more enemies.
  • The encounter has less than 35 seconds remaining.
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • Their Trueshot buff has more than 12 seconds remaining, ensuring maximum synergy with their cooldown window.
  • The encounter will end in less than 13 seconds, allowing a final burst before combat concludes.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Coordinated Assault is active with more than 7 seconds remaining and Power Infusion isn’t already active.
  • The Hunter isn’t using Coordinated Assault and Spearhead is on cooldown.
  • The Hunter hasn’t talented into Coordinated Assault or Spearhead.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • The Arcane Mage has just cast Arcane Surge as their previous spell, ensuring both cooldowns are aligned for maximum burst damage potential.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Combustion is active and has more than 6 seconds remaining, ensuring maximum cooldown overlap for burst damage.
  • the encounter will end within 25 seconds, allowing the full duration to be utilized before combat ends.
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not currently active on the Mage, prioritizing usage during their burst phase with Icy Veins for maximum damage synergy.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Xuen the White Tiger is active and Bloodlust is not active.
  • Xuen the White Tiger is active, Bloodlust is active, and Strike of the Windlord is on cooldown.
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • They activate Avenging Wrath, their core offensive cooldown.
  • They activate Crusade, a stacking damage-boosting ability (if using this talent).
  • Their target is affected by Execution Sentence, a debuff that detonates for heavy damage.
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • Voidform is active and Power Infusion is not already active.
  • Dark Ascension is active and Power Infusion is not already active.
  • They have the TWW Season 2 4-piece set bonus and Power Infusion is not already active.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • Their Deathmark bleed effect is actively ticking on the target.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • They have Shadow Dance active, as this amplifies their core burst window with abilities like Secret Technique and Eviscerate.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • They have Ascendance active to amplify their burst window, or
  • Ascendance won’t be available for 30+ seconds, allowing you to use Power Infusion without delaying their major cooldown synergy
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • Ascendance has over 7.5 seconds remaining (if they have Deeply Rooted Elements talented).
  • Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds are active (without Deeply Rooted Elements).
  • The fight is entering the final 20 seconds of a 2-minute cooldown window.
  • Their next major cooldown won’t be available for at least 120 seconds.
  • They haven’t talented into Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds.
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • Soul Rot is active and amplifying their damage output.
  • Other major offensive cooldowns (e.g., Darkglare, summon trinkets) are active, maximizing burst damage potential.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • The warlock's Wild Imps are about to despawn within the next 6 global cooldowns and a cast time, ensuring maximum damage during their active window.
  • The imp despawn timer aligns with your ability to cast Power Infusion before they expire, timing it to amplify their burst phase.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • their Summon Infernal is currently active, or
  • they are not using the Summon Infernal talent, or
  • the fight will end before they can use Summon Infernal again and there is enough time for a full Power Infusion duration, or
  • the fight ends within 15 seconds of their next available Summon Infernal cooldown.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • Colossus Smash is active on the target and the fight will last at least 135 more seconds.
  • The Warrior is in their Execute Phase (sub-20% target health) and Avatar is active.
  • The fight will end within 25 seconds.
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has more than 15 seconds remaining and the encounter lasts at least 135 seconds.
  • The target is in execute phase (below 20% health) and Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds.
